assertions.text: Table has at least one column name ending with '?' (e.g. 'Discount?' or 'Expected?')
Table has exactly 3 data rows (GOLD, SILVER, BRONZE)
assertions.evidence: Gold customer | GOLD | 20; Silver customer | SILVER | 10; Bronze customer | BRONZE | 0

assertions.text: Test method body contains only one assertEquals (or equivalent assertion) — not three
Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: Method body is single assertion line with no control flow

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: Scenario | tier | Discount? — Scenario is first column

assertions.text: Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title
If @Description is present, it provides context beyond what the table rows already express
assertions.evidence: @Description(...Order amount is 100...) provides fixed value context

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest
assertions.evidence: @Description then @TableTest is correct order for present annotations

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string), not string concatenation with +
assertions.evidence: Single line text (Order amount is 100...) does not require text block
